purpose: Four weeks of a factory process engineer's life. One durable fact class (nocturnal acid reflux, 8 occurrences across note/conversation channels) recurs but fits none of the existing source-channel dimensions and no existing semantic axis, because it is a recurring body-condition signal coupled to meal timing and workload. Tests whether the resident AI autonomously proposes a new observation axis instead of filing it under an unrelated dimension.
rule: Each model receives the resident stream in a fresh AIOS world. The oracle is evaluator-only.
